data.one_liner: Automatically update release and installation files in a local directory.
data.what_it_does: Provides an API and CLI tools to automatically update release and installation files in a local directory. It includes utilities to package releases into ZIP bundles and serve them via an HTTP server.
use_when: You need to implement self-updating capabilities for a local Dart application.
You want to generate release bundles and serve them over HTTP for multiple platforms.
avoid_when: You are deploying standard mobile apps via Google Play or the Apple App Store.
You do not need local file installation updates or custom release servers.
strengths: Includes built-in CLI tools for packing and serving releases.
Supports multiple platforms (Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux).
Integrates with HTTP providers and basic authentication for uploads.
weaknesses: Requires setting up and managing a custom release server for updates.
Documentation outside of the README relies entirely on external API docs.
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring a release JSON file for the packer and optionally running the release server CLI.
